title: Weather data shows strong northerly wind at FLIR1 altitude
summary: Merrick tells of Weather data shows strong northerly wind at FLIR1 altitude, about 2004 at Off Southern California, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we can look at the weather data from that time at that altitude and there's an extremely strong northerly wind

plain: FLIR1 is a short video shot in 2004 by the infrared camera of a Navy jet off Southern California, showing an object that some call the Tic Tac, a white oval shaped like the mint. A researcher named Merrick says on Jesse Michels' podcast that the weather records for that time and height show a very strong wind blowing from the north, and he credits a colleague named Yannick. That matters because it bears on whether the object was just drifting with the wind, like a balloon, or moving under its own power.
